subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: After the duplicate lifecycle path is removed, should cron `deferred` be a terminal public handoff status, a nonterminal waiting state, or an internal-only lifecycle state?
rationale: This choice changes persisted run logs, Gateway protocol, CLI exit behavior, plugin SDK/hooks, QA tooling, docs, and UI; the intended permanent compatibility contract cannot be inferred safely from the underlying bug.

options.title: Public terminal handoff
options.body: Define `deferred` as a completed handoff whose descendants continue independently, then align every consumer and prove fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Nonterminal waiting state
options.body: Keep cron and task state active until descendant-driven final synthesis completes.

options.title: Internal-only lifecycle
options.body: Preserve the existing public cron status union and represent yielded waiting only inside runtime state.

recommendation.title: Public terminal handoff
recommendation.body: Define `deferred` as a completed handoff whose descendants continue independently, then align every consumer and prove fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership spans the public cron protocol/status and Discord progress surfaces where this permanent product contract must be decided.
